list.title: Events
list.emptyBody: Create your first event. It stays a draft until you publish it.

create.title: New event
create.subtitle: Start with the basics. You can add the venue, tickets and more languages next.
create.name: Event name
create.languageHint: You can add the other languages later.
create.timezoneHint: Times are shown to buyers in this time zone.

details.title: Details
details.visibilityUnlisted: Unlisted: only people with the link

content.title: Text
content.intro: Write the event's text in each language you want to offer. Readers see their own language when it exists, otherwise the main language.
content.summaryHint: One or two sentences shown in listings.
content.descriptionHint: Leave an empty line between paragraphs.

venue.title: Venue
venue.searchHint: Venues are shared between organizations on CynSeat.
venue.noResults: No venues match. Add it below.
venue.name: Venue name

tickets.title: Ticket types
tickets.intro: Each ticket type has its own price and number of tickets.
tickets.name: Name
tickets.nameHint: For example Adult, Student or Supporter.
tickets.salesHint: Leave empty to sell from now until the event starts.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.ready: This event is ready to publish.
publish.org_not_approved: Your organization is approved by CynSeat
publish.missing_title: The event has a name in its main language
publish.missing_venue: A venue is chosen, or the event is marked as online
publish.starts_in_past: The start time is in the future
publish.no_ticket_types: There is at least one ticket type
publish.adminOnly: Only an organization admin can publish.
publish.cancelConfirm: Cancel this event? Buyers will see that it is cancelled. This cannot be undone.
publish.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
publish.payments_not_ready: Your organization can take payments, or every ticket is free

cover.title: Poster
cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB. Wide images (16:9) look best.
